title: Light form, thoughtful functionality
paragraphs: The Fota collection is a range of mobile conference tables designed with flexible space organization in mind.
The lift-up tabletop, which can be positioned vertically, makes it easy to quickly fold and store the tables, increasing the functionality of the room.
This solution works particularly well where a single space must serve multiple different functions throughout the day.
Fota supports meeting comfort and helps create a modern, organized work environment.
